name: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)

deployments_detail.company: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)
deployments_detail.use: Buddycom live voice communication platform with AI-based digital assistant deployed across ~500 directly-operated MUJI stores to improve customer service and register operations [Science Arts Inc. (Buddycom)]

deployments_detail.company: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)
deployments_detail.use: In-house AI model predicting hourly store foot-traffic from 5 years of visitor data plus weather forecasts, feeding staff scheduling and real-time POS-driven automatic replenishment/order optimization to distribution centers [Ryohin Keikaku (in-house on internal data lake, Staging/Raw/Insight layers)]

deployments_detail.company: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)
deployments_detail.use: Artly autonomous Barista Bot (later 'Jarvis') using a Vision-Language-Action AI model to make specialty coffee drinks in MUJI stores (Portland, New York, Vancouver, Toronto) [Artly (Vision-Language-Action model)]
deployments_detail.value: ~70 cups/day at Toronto flagship; nearly 1 million cups served since inception; makes 28+ drink types

deployments_detail.company: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)
deployments_detail.use: ID-POS data analytics foundation combining machine learning / AI for demand and trend forecasting, marketing reporting, and order optimization built on a self-managed data platform [Ryohin Keikaku (in-house data analytics platform)]

deployments_detail.company: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)
deployments_detail.use: Google Cloud Recommendations AI powering personalized article recommendations in the MUJI passport / MUJI app and product recommendations on the EC (net store) site, tuned with diversity controls to fit brand values [Google Cloud (Recommendations AI / Vertex AI); implementation partner System Support Inc.]
deployments_detail.value: +0.5 percentage point CTR uplift on recommended articles (A/B tested); EC recommendations internalized and delivered in ~1 month

deployments_detail.company: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)
deployments_detail.use: MUJI Promotion Insights Hub: causal ML plus Gemini Enterprise letting staff query, in natural language, how EC browsing drives in-store sales (integrating Google Analytics, weather, demographics, store layout) [Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise, causal ML)]
deployments_detail.value: EC access estimated to contribute ~8% of store sales during a 2-month shipping suspension; regional drivers up to 56% (Hokkaido thermal underwear) and 49% (Osaka space-saving furniture)

deployments_detail.company: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)
deployments_detail.use: AI influenza outbreak forecasting displayed in-store on a monitor at MUJI Grand Front Osaka, pairing 4-level 2-week-ahead flu risk forecasts with relevant preventive products [Hitachi Social Information Services (Hitachi Infectious Disease Forecast Service)]

deployments_detail.company: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)
deployments_detail.use: Helpfeel AI-FAQ intent-prediction search deployed for store and net-store customer self-service to deflect inquiries during peak sales periods (e.g. MUJI Week) [Helpfeel (Nota Inc.)]
deployments_detail.value: 70% reduction in inquiries during peak periods; active users grew 150%+; FAQ publishing time cut from 2 weeks to immediate

deployments_detail.company: Muji Co., Ltd (Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd.)
deployments_detail.use: AI 'staff' avatars providing conversational product recommendations and Q&A in the MUJI Ginza virtual store within the metaverse (service ran until March 2025) [KDDI (αU place) with AIQ conversational AI]
